latest_release.body:
## This is a security release, upgrading is recommended

[![Download it](https://img.shields.io/badge/12.0.2-DOWNLOAD_GLPI-green.svg?logo=php&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/glpi-project/glpi/releases/download/12.0.2/glpi-12.0.2.tgz) [![Official Docker image](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Official_image-1d63ed.svg?logo=docker&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://hub.docker.com/r/glpi/glpi)

You will find below the list of security issues fixed in this bugfixes version:

* [SECURITY - High] Privilege Escalation via the legacy API
* [SECURITY - High] OAuth server consent bypass
* [SECURITY - High] Account takeover via an embed dashboard
* [SECURITY - High] Stored XSS in document downloads via API-written filenames
* [SECURITY - High] Account takeover via password-reset hijacking

The [full changelog is available](https://github.com/glpi-project/glpi/milestone/99?closed=1) for more details.

We would like to thank all people who contributed to this new version and all those who contributes regularly to the GLPI project!

Regards.
